jobs.description:
Description:
**Department:** Programs and Services


**FLSA Exemption Status:** full\-time, non\-exempt

**Location:** Denver, CO


**Supervisor:** Director of Essential Services

**Position Overview:**


The Hospitality Program Manager leads the programming and operations of The Gathering Place’s Hospitality Program, including the prepared foods program, food pantry, and clothing boutique. Leadership of this program requires promoting and maintaining a low barrier, trauma informed environment within the hospitality programs. The program manager leads and collaborates with Hospitality staff, volunteers, and other community partners to ensure low barrier access to high\-quality and nutritious food and essential clothing items. The program manager must operate with a broad understanding of the food and nutritional insecurities and essential needs of our community to deliver quality outcomes of the overall program.


You might be a great fit at TGP if you have a passion and commitment for our mission, the services we provide, and for addressing the systemic barriers that our members face through a trauma\-informed approach.

  



**Core Accountabilities:**

* Use cultural humility and trauma\-informed care when interacting with members, staff, volunteers, and community partners, including mindfulness and flexibility regarding food preferences, sensitivities, and needs.
* Maintain a physically and psychologically safe environment for members, staff, and volunteers.
* Lead inventory management for the hospitality program; lead and execute regular ordering processes in order to ensure kitchen supplies and ingredients remain fully stocked, while remaining within the establish program budget.
* Create and lead strong systems and protocols that are consistent with the objectives of TGP’s clothing boutique and food pantry programs
* Create weekly menus reflecting a wide variety of cultural influences and dietary needs. Engage with and lead Hospitality staff, volunteers, and meal sponsors in the daily production and serving of high\-quality meals, as well as needs related to the Boutique and Pantry as they arise.
* Complete all program documentation and data entry in a timely manner to meet organizational, legal, and contractual standards and reporting requirements.
* Ensure compliance with operational standards, health department regulations, and all federal/state/local laws.
* Provide supportive 1:1 supervision to all program staff that focuses on performance, growth, and progress.
* Work as a member of the program manager team to resolve issues across TGP programs, coordinate resources, and provide organizational leadership
* Coordinate scheduling of staff, volunteers, and community partners to promote effective and efficient program operations
* Other duties as assigned by supervisor

 **Compensation \& Benefits:**

* 37\.5\-hour workweek
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Life insurance plans
* 403(b) retirement savings plan
* Financial advising services
* Generous paid time off
* Long\- and short\-term disability plan
* Robust training and professional development opportunities
* Free breakfast and lunch
* Employee Assistance Program
* Free CorePower Yoga membership

 **About The Gathering Place:**


Founded in 1986, The Gathering Place (TGP) supports women, gender\-diverse people, and their children in building stable lives through home, health, purpose, and community programs. We are driven by our values of community, safety, inclusivity, empowerment, and hope. We envision a Colorado where all marginalized groups experiencing homelessness and instability have pathways to security.


As a trauma\-informed, low\-barrier organization, we remove unnecessary or harmful requirements that prevent members of the community from accessing our services when they need them most—from essential services like meals, showers, and laundry to long\-term support like housing\-focused case management and physical, mental, and sexual health care. Members choose which of our services they want to take advantage of, giving them the autonomy they need to rebuild their lives.


Requirements:
**Requirements:**

* Able to bend, lift, push, pull, and hold/carry at least 15 lbs.
* Able to perform job duties in a variety of fluctuating temperatures.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Current knowledge of, or willingness to learn about, food justice and food and nutritional insecurity.
* Compassionate and empathetic approach to working with diverse populations.
* Current knowledge of, or willingness to learn, how to operate a computer and other office machinery, such as a copy machine or printer, and office software, such as Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and other programs.
* Preferred: Minimum three years of experience in food service or in a food service/culinary training program.
* Preferred: Minimum of one year of experience in a supervisory role.
* Preferred: Knowledge of, or lived experience with, homelessness, poverty, women and trans issues, substance misuse.


If you’re excited about this role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with the requirements in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this or other roles within the organization!

 **Commitment to Equity and Inclusion:**


The Gathering Place is committed to Accessibility, Belonging, Liberation, and Equity (ABLE) work to advance marginalized communities from oppression, exploitation, and discrimination while uplifting and celebrating them. We are taking collective action towards dismantling systemic structures and empowering underrepresented identities.

**Join a team that’s transforming mental healthcare.** Founded by psychiatrists, Headlight is more than a company: it’s a movement. A movement that exists on the front lines of the mental health crisis, transforming the way people access care and the way clinicians deliver it. In order to help people in their time of need and ensure that every person who comes to us has options, we are transparent about our capabilities, treatments, and coverage, we champion innovation, and we leverage our rich data to continuously implement better ways of delivering care. **Our mission is simple but powerful: Improving lives, one session at a time.**  

Our highly skilled and principled clinical team enjoys autonomy and institutional support so they can put their focus where it should be: on improving patient outcomes. Our clinicians want to do more than help individual clients, so they work to affect the system as a whole, elevating standards of care so that their efforts reverberate far beyond what they could do in private practice.  

As the most trusted behavioral health partner in the Western U.S., we’ve established deep relationships that give us unparalleled access, interoperability, and first\-priority referrals. This exclusivity, combined with our best\-in\-class coordinated care and feedback loops, results in superior outcomes and cost savings.  

Our services are convenient, accessible, and expert, combining personalized client engagement with advanced technology to enhance, not replace, human connection. Indeed, we hold that human\-to\-human relationships are indispensable, so from the match to the session to the time between sessions, we provide whole person care so nobody falls through the cracks and there is a brighter path forward for all.  


The Care Coordination Team’s objective is to facilitate a frictionless experience for both clients and clinicians working with  

Headlight. Clinicians work with Headlight because we take care of the important administrative parts of their job for them.  

Clients come to Headlight because we ensure they are matched with world\-class mental health providers, and we make it  

easy to get the help they need without jumping through hoops or feeling frustrated. And our Care Coordination team is  

the engine that makes this all happen.

As a Client Care Coordinator, you serve as a vital link between our clients and clinical team, ensuring that each care plan  

is executed seamlessly. You’ll do this by aligning clinician availability with client needs by managing calendars,  

rescheduling appointments, and optimizing clinician schedules for maximum efficiency. You will also act as the first  

point of contact for client inquiries through phone, text, and email—delivering timely, compassionate, and professional  

support. You will support our clinicians by keeping them informed of relevant updates, schedule changes, and client  

preferences to help them deliver the best care possible. This role is essential in fostering a smooth, supportive care  

experience for both clients and clinicians by ensuring communication is clear, plans are followed, and needs are  

proactively met.
### **Our Pillars**

* **Make things easier.**
* **Forge genuine connections.**
* **Elevate the standard.**

### **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Client Care Coordination: Facilitate the execution of a Clinician developed care plan for clients in need of outpatient mental health services; answer calls, reply to text messages \& emails, and assist clients in their scheduling needs.
* Clinical Support: Provide administrative support to clinicians and their clients by backing up the Clinical Support Team. This includes assisting with documentation, scheduling logistics, and any other operational needs that contribute to seamless care delivery.
* Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the Clinical, Billing, and Intake Teams to ensure continuity of care and streamlined communication. Help facilitate efficient teamwork by acting as a liaison across departments.
* Resource Coordination: Assist clients in navigating the healthcare system by coordinating services both within Headlight and externally. Tasks may include rescheduling appointments, coordinating with pharmacies, resolving insurance or billing issues, and connecting clients with necessary medical or mental health resources.
* Monitoring and Follow\-Up: Regularly track client progress and ensure care is delivered according to established plans. Complete follow\-ups after appointments, confirm future visits are scheduled, and carry out all assigned tasks related to client care coordination.
* Client Satisfaction: Serve as a reliable, empathetic point of contact for clients, ensuring their needs are met and their experience with Headlight is supportive, professional, and responsive.
* Data Entry, Tasking, and Record Keeping: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date client records by entering information into the system in a timely and detailed manner. Track tasks, document client interactions, and ensure all care coordination is properly logged.

**About the Fund for Guaranteed Income**

The Fund for Guaranteed Income (F4GI) directs power and resources into the hands of the people — so everyone can determine the course of their lives.

We partner with community organizations and governments to run pilot programs that reimagine systems, including the social safety net and the criminal legal system, and advocate for more efficient, dignified, and inclusive forms of support.

To date, most of our work involves direct cash transfers. We built the Compton Pledge — the largest city\-based guaranteed income program in US history — and have supported more than 20 pilot programs nationwide. We design and implement pilot programs, build technology, and conduct research to make the case for policies that meaningfully expand support.

Beyond cash, we build tools that address the broader needs of the communities we serve. Over the past five years, our positive\-impact technology projects have assisted some of the hardest\-to\-reach community members.

**About the AI Dividend**

AI is impacting jobs that provide security and mobility for millions of Americans. Yet our ability to respond is at a particularly weak point, hurt by uncertainty about the speed and scale of AI's impact.

Fortunately, we don't need to know the future to start preparing.

The AI Dividend is a pilot program that provides income support and reskilling to workers displaced by AI, generating data needed for an effective response. We are exploring:

* How to identify AI displacement on an individual level
* How workers navigate and overcome AI displacement
* How income support can support the road to re\-employment

The AI Dividend is the latest program from the Fund for Guaranteed Income (F4GI), a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization that has run more than 20 cash transfer programs nationwide.

**The AI Dividend is not a guaranteed income pilot program.** We aim to test both cash and alternative forms of support to understand what displaced workers are asking for — and what really helps people overcome AI displacement.

**The role**

The AI Dividend is seeking a member of the founding team to help build this program from the ground up. As Program Manager, you will work directly with F4GI's Executive Director and our core team to keep the program organized, remove distractions, and solve problems so we can learn as much as possible from each stage of the program and scale.

The AI Dividend is run by a small, core team. Like a startup, every person wears multiple hats and is expected to play a role in different areas of the project.

Your work will be concentrated in:

* **Program Operations**: Making sure the program is running smoothly, finding and proposing solutions to pain points.
* **Program Design**: Connecting with directly impacted workers, workforce development providers, and AI researchers to ensure their input and expertise are built into the DNA of this program.
* **Program Strategy**: Helping us stay connected to what is most important and triage between competing priorities.

Your work will also touch on:

* **Fundraising**: Supporting our team in finding partners interested in supporting our growth.
* **Research**: Coordinating research activities (interviews, surveys) and keeping outputs organized.
* **External Communications**: Contributing to our work sharing the impact and stories from this program more broadly.

**How do I know if I'm a good fit?**

The AI Dividend is being built in real time — the work involves a lot of unknowns and experimentation. We are looking for someone with:

* experience in a small startup or similar fast\-paced environment who is comfortable working with uncertainty and ambiguity
* a demonstrated track record of making good decisions, quickly, with limited information — and pivoting when things don't work out
* a bias for action and a love of feedback — you understand the concept of "best right now"
* a strong personal organization system — you ask questions and gather context intuitively so you always know what is most important

**Onboarding will be limited.** You will be expected to figure out systems and ask questions so you can hit the ground running.

You are expected to use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT daily. Ideal applicants are highly proficient with these tools — you have developed your own workflows and can help the team level up. Comfort with tools like Cursor is a bonus.

You are actively engaged with AI as a topic — reading, thinking, discussing, following the field. AI policy or research is a strong plus, but you don't need to have formal research or policy experience as long as you bring useful and interesting perspectives to the team. You are an excellent candidate if you can help us connect to the right partners throughout the AI space.
